about: The Workbench icons of the Methane drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Puff from the game's own docs/puff.gif (GPL 2, like the game), its background made clear. Methane-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Methane.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Methane.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-methane, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
